title: Stand-Bound
description:
A Jojo's Bizarre Adventure Palladium addon made by me (Norf)
There is many stand's from every part. 30+ stands.
body:
**A Jojo's Bizzare Adventure Mod**

It adds many stands, hamon, vampirism, spin, and more to come (Pillarmen).
